title: Forensic Analysis Confirms US-Made Raytheon Precision Munitions Used in Kuhestak Wedding Attack
text:
Forensic Analysis Confirms US-Made Raytheon Precision Munitions Used in Kuhestak Wedding Attack"

"**HORMOZGAN PROVINCE, Iran** – In the aftermath of a deadly American military strike targeting a wedding ceremony in the Kuhestak district of Sirik County, the Chief Justice of Hormozgan Province has visited the site and issued urgent judicial directives regarding the investigation."

"**Mojtaba Ghahremani** announced that the technical specifications and manufacturer of the recovered ordnance fragments have been conclusively identified through advanced forensic analysis, technical data processing, and high-resolution image examination."

"According to Ghahremani, meticulous data-mining of the recovered debris, alongside a detailed epigraphic (inscription) analysis, has definitively proven that the remnants belong to the armed forces of the United States of America."

"Critical evidence includes a registered U.S. military and government identification code engraved on the weapon's casing. Cross-referencing this code with the U.S. Defense Logistics Agency (DLA) supply-chain database confirmed that the munition is exclusively manufactured by the American defense contractor **Raytheon**."

"Additionally, technical warning engravings on the warhead's body highlight the extreme sensitivity of its pyrotechnic fuze activation circuit. The markings further indicate that the external casing temperature reaches **450 degrees Fahrenheit (232 degrees Celsius)** during supersonic flight and upon impact."

""
"Reported by Iranian judiciary media (Mizan Online), September 5, 2026.
